top_signals.title: Innolight Is Said Set to Price Hong Kong Listing Below Maximum
top_signals.summary: Zhongji Innolight Co. is telling prospective investors it is on track to price its HK$53.4 billion ($6.8 billion) Hong Kong listing below the maximum, according to people familiar with the matter, as the company moves closer to sealing the city’s biggest first-time share sale in seven years.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Why Trump's new tariff blitz is very different this time round
top_signals.summary: President Trump on Friday launched a fresh round of tariffs targeting 60 trading partners, including the European Union, China, and the U.K.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
